name.label: Name on screen
name.description: A short name, e.g. Work. Empty: the service's name.

alerts.label: Alerts
alerts.description: Warn before this calendar's meetings: the screen lights up, the LED blinks and a sound plays. Off: its meetings are only shown.

alert_minutes.label: Warn before
alert_minutes.description: How long before a meeting the bar warns: the screen lights up, the LED blinks and a sound plays. Dismiss it with OK or Start.

alert_at_start.label: Warn again at the start
alert_at_start.description: If nobody dismissed the first warning, warn once more when the meeting begins.

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: Play a sound with each warning.

all_day.label: All-day events
all_day.description: Show all-day events in the agenda. They never warn.

refresh_minutes.label: Check calendars every
refresh_minutes.description: Each check reads every calendar again; services update their links with a delay of their own.
